category_summary: **NousCon event recap** leads the section: **Teknium**'s [thank-you post](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-89f72406a2ae) (1,116 likes, 42K views) recaps the flagship gathering and spotlights CEO **dillonrolnick**'s opening theme that "AI is a tool for liberation not domination," a framing the community clearly embraced. The official **@NousResearch** account's cryptic ["That was crazy"](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-a7c16fc8f405) post exploded to 123K views and 1,102 likes, almost certainly tied to a NousCon moment — vague on content but the batch's biggest reach, so it ranks high despite low substance. **Oh My Hermes ecosystem** is the most Hermes-on-topic thread: **rlaope**'s [launch post](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-e02d802dbcaf) for the open-source harness wiring **Hermes Agent** into IDEs (subagent workflows, token savings) drew the strongest community engagement, followed by the [**5k GitHub stars** milestone](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-7d19b8088ceb) and a fan-built [**omher** info site](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-3d97c8a84813) covering **Oh My Hermes** and **Kami Agent** — strong signals of genuine grassroots momentum. **Competitive/privacy debate** provides the spiciest discourse: **Teknium** [alleged **Grok CLI** scanned and uploaded all git projects](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-95c4e3e123ac) from users' machines (including untouched ones), [called out a competitor's lack of an open-source license](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-7d2c3898f1a6), and [quipped that handing a whole codebase to xAI "seems wild"](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-348fcf13f038) — positioning Nous's open-source ethos against closed agent tooling. A viral **@NousResearch** ["lol" reply to **OpenBot_**](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-0c3e40826af7) (726 likes, 40.6K views) shows the account's casual replies can outperform substantive posts. **Community showcases**: the official account's ["New use case unlocked"](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-ae28d4745d81) nod and a ["Banger"](/?date=2026-11-01&category=social#item-136f78b1f3e4) endorsement reflect warm, playful org-community rapport. Long tail of emoji replies, greetings, and NousCon pleasantries adds color but little newsletter value.

A new hermes based harness is taking off right now.

if you like harnesses like omp or omo, if your hermes plugins are bottlenecking, if you need real memory retention, or if you wanna master graph engineering definitely look into this.

GitHub: https://t.co/g1exHwWK5E

oh-my-hermes (omher) bakes serious coding firepower straight into hermes agent. using subagent workflows, it ships results multiple times faster, saves a ton of tokens, and hits over 2x memory recall and accuracy.

completely open source and it already hit 5k stars crazy fast. go check it out.

#hermes #harness
